description: Discover optional task-specific SocialSeal guidance after identifying the requested work. For a content calendar or posting schedule, select socialseal-social-plan-builder; for video/editor/UGC briefs, select socialseal-creator-briefing. Loading guidance does not execute generation tools. Skills are not prerequisites for basic operations. Returns each skill's name and frontmatter description (so you can route without reading every SKILL.md), file paths, shared references, the install command, and the archive download info.
